name: collage-studio
description: Professional multi-photo collage studio for web, iOS and Android

scripts.build:web: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @collage/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @collage/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:core && npm run start --workspace @collage/mobile
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspace @collage/core && npm run test --workspace @collage/web
scripts.test:core: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspace @collage/core
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspace @collage/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @collage/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @collage/mobile
scripts.package: npm run build:web && npm run package --workspace @collage/web
